name: Coconut candy
summary: Soft candy of coconut milk and sugar, warm at the kiln or wrapped to take home. It is not a restaurant course. Vietnam Tourism says more than 300 factories. That count is one page. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Ben Tre. The rural page shows the boil, the cut, and the wrap at Cồn Phụng. The wrapping table shown is on Cồn Quy.
culture: Vietnam Tourism says more than 300 coconut-candy factories. That count is one page. The national rural page shows the work at Cồn Phụng and does not print a count.
The plain candy is coconut milk and sugar. Candy, milk, oil, and shell craft are the products of the palms. The rural page says more than 500 coconut-shell objects. That count is not a candy count.
texture: The candy is soft. Eat it warm at the kiln, or carry the wrapped pieces.
taste: Coconut milk and sugar. No other flavor was printed.
howToEat: Eat it warm at the kiln, or take the wrapped pieces home. It is not a restaurant course.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The rural page places the boil at Cồn Phụng. The photograph of the wrapping table is on Cồn Quy. Town-boat kilns are the other area. No shop is named as a pick.
seoTitle: Coconut candy in Ben Tre — warm at the kiln
seoDescription: Kẹo dừa is soft candy of coconut milk and sugar, warm at the kiln or wrapped to take home. More than 300 factories is one page. The price is check on arrival.
